summary.headline: Lord of the Ascendant in Twelve Houses
summary.text: Interpretations of a planet in the houses of the Sun, Venus, Mercury, and its own house, followed by Chapter VIII on the lord of the ascendant in the twelve houses, including effects on inheritance, wealth, siblings, travel, parents, lawsuits, and honor.
